title: Accumulating Snapshot Fact For Process

slots.description: The pipeline process with defined milestones tracked as one evolving row per instance.

known_failure_modes: Milestones are appended as new rows instead of merged in place, so one instance becomes many.
A non-idempotent re-run re-fills milestone columns with wrong dates on replay.
Lag columns go negative when milestone events arrive out of order.

title: Aggregate Fact Rollup For Grain

slots.description: The atomic base fact that the aggregate rolls up to a coarser reporting grain.
The coarser aggregate grain the rollup fact is materialized at for query speed.

known_failure_modes: Non-additive measures are pre-aggregated, so drill-down totals disagree with the base fact.
The aggregate is not invalidated when the base fact reloads and serves stale rollups.

title: Bridge Table For Many To Many Relation

slots.description: The many-to-many relationship between two dimensions resolved to one row per valid pair.

known_failure_modes: Duplicate pairs inflate downstream joins because the pair key is not unique.
Allocation weights do not sum to one per group, so apportioned measures are wrong.

title: Cohort Analysis For Event

slots.description: The signup or first-activity event that assigns each subject to a cohort.

known_failure_modes: The cohort anchor event is not deduplicated per subject, so one subject lands in two cohorts.
Timezone handling shifts the anchor across a period boundary and mislabels the cohort.

title: Conformed Dimension For Shared Entity

slots.description: The shared entity aligned to one attribute contract and surrogate key across marts.

known_failure_modes: Two marts resolve different surrogate keys for the entity, so drill-across cannot align.
Attribute domains disagree between sources and the conformance contract is silently violated.

title: Cumulative Metric For Measure

slots.description: The measure accumulated over a trailing window into a running or period-to-date metric.

known_failure_modes: The window frame is unbounded on the wrong side, so the cumulative includes future rows.
The grain reset boundary is missing, so period-to-date never resets at the period edge.

title: Date Dimension For Calendar

slots.description: The calendar variant generated as a conformed date dimension such as fiscal or gregorian.

known_failure_modes: The generated date range does not cover the fact date span, so facts orphan on the join.
Fiscal period boundaries are hard-coded and disagree with the declared calendar policy.

title: Deduplicate Latest Per Key

slots.description: The relation whose duplicate rows are collapsed to the latest record per key.
The business key that identifies duplicates, keeping the row with the newest version.

known_failure_modes: The recency ordering ties on the tiebreak column, so a non-deterministic row survives each run.
The dedup key is coarser than the real grain, so distinct records are wrongly collapsed.

title: Deduplicate Across Sets For Entity

slots.description: The first source set whose records may overlap the second on the dedup key.
The second source set whose records may overlap the first on the dedup key.
The deduplicated union keeping one surviving record per key across both sets.

known_failure_modes: Survivorship priority between the sets is undefined, so which duplicate wins varies per run.
The dedup key differs subtly between the two sets, so true duplicates are not matched.

title: Dimension Model For Entity

slots.description: The business entity keyed one row per member with a surrogate and unknown member.

known_failure_modes: A non-unique natural key produces duplicate surrogate keys for one entity member.
No unknown member is reserved, so facts with missing or late keys drop out of joins.

title: Factless Fact For Event

slots.description: The occurrence or coverage event recorded as keys only with no numeric measure.

known_failure_modes: A synthetic count measure is added and then summed, double counting occurrences.
Coverage and event semantics are mixed in one factless fact, confusing non-occurrence queries.

title: Full Refresh Rebuild For Table

slots.description: The incremental target dropped and rebuilt in full to recover from drift or a logic change.

known_failure_modes: The full refresh drops history that only ever existed in the incremental target.
The rebuild reruns against a shrunken source window and silently loses older rows.

title: Funnel For Ordered Steps

slots.description: The ordered multi-step flow whose per-step reach and conversion is measured.

known_failure_modes: Step ordering is not enforced, so a later step counts subjects who skipped an earlier one.
The conversion window is unbounded, so unrelated later events are attributed to the funnel.

title: Generic Test Kind For Column

slots.description: The model whose declared column is asserted by the chosen generic test kind.
The generic test kind bound to the column such as unique, notnull, relationships, or acceptedvalues.

known_failure_modes: A single column is tested when the real key is composite, so duplicates slip past uniqueness.
The test is declared on a legitimately nullable column and fails on valid data.

title: Incremental Append For Table

slots.description: The append-only target whose new source rows past the high-water mark are inserted.

known_failure_modes: An off-by-one boundary re-inserts the last batch, so replaying the window duplicates rows.
Append mode is used where rows update after load, so stale versions accumulate.

title: Incremental Delete Insert For Table

slots.description: The target whose matched keys are deleted then re-inserted from the incoming batch.

known_failure_modes: The delete predicate is wider than the insert set, so unrelated rows are removed.
A crash between delete and insert leaves the target missing the deleted keys.

title: Incremental Insert Overwrite For Table

slots.description: The partitioned target whose whole affected partitions are atomically replaced.

known_failure_modes: The partition predicate is misaligned, so unaffected partitions are overwritten and lose data.
A row straddles the partition boundary and is dropped when its partition is replaced.

title: Incremental Merge For Table

slots.description: The upsert target matched on a unique key to update changed rows and insert new keys.

known_failure_modes: The merge key is not unique, so a key ends up with several rows and latest state is ambiguous.
A non-idempotent merge double-applies the same batch and inflates measure columns.

title: Intermediate Model For Transformation Step

slots.description: The upstream staging relation feeding this intermediate step.
The single purposeful transformation verb this intermediate isolates for reuse.

known_failure_modes: The step bundles two unrelated responsibilities, so no downstream mart can reuse it cleanly.
The intermediate is reused at a grain it was never built for and silently fans out rows.

title: Junk Dimension For Flag Bundle

slots.description: The bundle of low-cardinality flags and indicators collapsed into one junk dimension.

known_failure_modes: A high-cardinality attribute is folded in, so the junk dimension explodes in row count.
Flag combinations that never co-occur are pre-generated, bloating the dimension.

title: Mart Model For Entity

slots.description: The business entity whose definitional single-grain mart is being built.

known_failure_modes: The declared grain is ambiguous, so consumer sums double-count across mixed grains.
Staging column names leak into the business layer and break the stable consumer interface.

title: Table Materialization For Model

slots.description: The model persisted as a full physical table rebuilt from scratch on each run.

known_failure_modes: A table materialization is used for a huge source where an incremental was needed.
The rebuild is not atomic, so consumers read a half-built relation mid-run.

title: View Materialization For Model

slots.description: The model exposed as a view whose SQL is re-evaluated on every read.

known_failure_modes: A view over expensive logic is queried in a hot path and re-computes on every read.
The view depends on a relation dropped by a defer build, so it errors at read time.

title: Medallion Bronze Land For Source

slots.description: The source system extract landed verbatim into the bronze raw layer.

known_failure_modes: Bronze silently coerces types instead of landing raw, hiding upstream data problems.
The extract row count is not reconciled against the landed table, so partial loads pass unnoticed.

title: Medallion Gold Model For Domain

slots.description: The business domain whose consumer-facing gold mart is aggregated from silver.

known_failure_modes: Gold re-derives metric logic instead of referencing the metric spec, so definitions drift per mart.
A many-to-one join in gold inflates measures because the join cardinality was not declared.

title: Medallion Silver Model For Domain

slots.description: The business domain whose cleaned, conformed silver model is being built.

known_failure_modes: Cleaning rules for the domain are hard-coded in the silver body and diverge from the schema contract.
Silver quietly filters rows the gold layer needs, so downstream totals under-count.

title: Semantic Metric For Measure

slots.description: The silver domain table the measure aggregates over as its semantic base.
The additive measure and aggregation defined once as a governed semantic metric.

known_failure_modes: The measure is defined non-additively but aggregated with SUM, so rollups over-count.
The metric hard-codes a filter that belongs to a query, so every consumer inherits it.

title: Metric Query Compile For Metric

slots.description: The governed metric compiled with a requested grain and filters into an executable query result.

known_failure_modes: The requested grain is finer than the metric supports, so the compile fans out the measure.
A join path is ambiguous and the compiler silently picks one, changing the result set.

title: One Big Table Flatten For Fact

slots.description: The fact flattened with all related dimension attributes into one denormalized table.

known_failure_modes: The flatten pre-joins a many-to-many relationship and inflates the fact grain.
Late-changing dimension attributes are frozen into the OBT and go stale versus the star.

title: Period Over Period Compare For Metric

slots.description: The metric compared against its own prior period to compute change and growth.

known_failure_modes: A missing prior period is treated as zero instead of null, so growth spikes to a false infinity.
Partial current periods are compared to full prior periods, understating the change.

title: Periodic Snapshot Fact For Grain

slots.description: The periodic snapshot grain that records one row per entity per regular interval.

known_failure_modes: A missing interval leaves a gap so period-over-period math silently skips a snapshot.
Semi-additive balances are summed across the period grain as if fully additive.

title: Pivot Long To Wide For Dimension

slots.description: The long-format measure table pivoted into one column per dimension value.
The dimension whose distinct values become the pivoted output columns.

known_failure_modes: A new dimension value appears with no pivot column, so its measure is silently dropped.
Null and zero are conflated in empty pivot cells, so downstream math misreads absence.

title: Ratio Metric From Measures

slots.description: The base numerator metric combined with a denominator into a derived ratio.
The derived ratio metric expressed as numerator over denominator at a shared grain.

known_failure_modes: Numerator and denominator are aggregated at different grains, so the ratio is computed on mismatched totals.
A ratio of averages is taken instead of an average of ratios, biasing the result.

title: Relationships Test For Fact

slots.description: The fact whose foreign keys are asserted to resolve to their parent dimension rows.

known_failure_modes: The test points at the wrong parent grain, so valid keys are reported as orphans.
Nulls are not handled, so legitimately null foreign keys either false-fail or hide real orphans.

title: Retention Curve For Cohort

slots.description: The cohort table whose per-period returning-subject retention curve is computed.

known_failure_modes: The denominator uses the current cohort size instead of the original, inflating late-period retention.
Partial trailing periods are shown as full, so the final retention point reads artificially low.

title: Role Playing Dimension For Role

slots.description: The base dimension that is aliased into a role-specific view of itself.
The role the dimension plays for a specific fact foreign key such as order or ship date.

known_failure_modes: The role alias is not applied, so two fact keys collapse onto one ambiguous dimension join.
A physical copy is made per role instead of an alias, so the dimensions drift apart.

title: Row Count Reconcile For Model

slots.description: The model whose built row count is reconciled against the source expected count under tolerance.

known_failure_modes: The tolerance is set so wide it hides a real halving of the row count.
Intended filtering is ignored when computing the expected count, so every run flags a false variance.

title: SCD Type 1 Overwrite Dimension For Entity

slots.description: The entity whose changing attributes are overwritten in place with no history.

known_failure_modes: Type 1 is chosen where history matters, so prior attribute values are lost forever.
A non-idempotent overwrite re-applies stale values when the same batch is replayed.

title: SCD Type 2 History Dimension For Entity

slots.description: The entity whose attribute history is preserved as versioned rows per key.

known_failure_modes: Overlapping validity windows appear for one key because the prior version was not closed.
More than one current row exists per key after a merge that missed the current flag.
A non-idempotent re-run opens duplicate versions for unchanged rows.

title: SCD Type 3 Prior Value Dimension For Entity

slots.description: The entity whose limited prior-value columns retain one step of change history.

known_failure_modes: Type 3 is used where full history is required, so changes older than one step are lost.
The prior-value column is overwritten before the current value is captured, dropping a transition.

title: Seed Load For Reference Lookup

slots.description: The version-controlled reference lookup being loaded into a typed seed table.

known_failure_modes: Loose type inference mistypes a numeric code as text, so downstream joins silently miss.
The seed table drifts from the committed file because the load was not a full replace.

title: Sessionization For Event Stream

slots.description: The ordered event stream grouped into sessions by an inactivity gap threshold.

known_failure_modes: The inactivity gap is mis-set, so distinct sessions merge or a single session splits.
Events are not partitioned per subject before the gap scan, so sessions cross subjects.

title: Singular Test For Business Rule

slots.description: The model the hand-written singular test queries for rows violating the rule.
The specific business rule expressed as a violation-selecting query for this model.

known_failure_modes: The query returns passing rows instead of failing ones, so a violation never trips the test.
The test is written but not wired into the suite, so the rule is never enforced.

title: Snapshot SCD2 For Table

slots.description: The source table snapshotted into a type-2 history relation on each run.

known_failure_modes: The snapshot check strategy misses a mutable column, so a real change opens no new version.
A re-run against an unchanged source opens duplicate versions for every key.

title: Source Definition For System

slots.description: The upstream system whose landing relation is declared as a named source.

known_failure_modes: Models hard-code the raw location instead of the source handle, so a rename breaks lineage.
The declared column list drifts from the actual landing table and the contract goes stale.

title: Source Freshness Check For System

slots.description: The source system whose staleness is measured against warn and error thresholds.

known_failure_modes: The loaded-at column reflects transform time not load time, so real staleness is hidden.
A timezone mismatch inflates or masks the observed lag and the threshold fires wrongly.

title: Staging Model For Source

slots.description: The raw landed source relation to standardize one-to-one into a typed staging table.

known_failure_modes: The bound source has no stable typed contract, so the staging cast list drifts every run.
A join or aggregate sneaks into the staging body and breaks the one-to-one source grain.
A vendor column the source drops is still referenced downstream because staging never re-exposed it.

title: Star Schema Assemble For Process

slots.description: The business process whose fact and conformed dimensions assemble into a star mart.

known_failure_modes: A dimension is joined at the wrong grain, so the assembled star over-counts measures.
An unconformed dimension is wired in, so the star cannot drill across to sibling processes.

title: Surrogate Key Map For Entity

slots.description: The entity whose natural key is hashed into a deterministic surrogate key map.

known_failure_modes: Sequence-based keys are used, so the surrogate changes on every rebuild and facts mis-join.
Null normalization differs across models, so the same natural key hashes to different surrogates.

title: Transaction Fact For Grain

slots.description: The single event grain at which the transaction fact records one row per event.

known_failure_modes: Natural keys are left on the fact instead of surrogate lookups, so dimension joins mis-resolve.
Header and line grains are mixed in one table, so joins fan out and measures over-count.
A missed surrogate lookup leaves orphan facts that vanish from inner joins.

title: Union All Aligned For Sources

slots.description: The first record set stacked into the union under a shared aligned schema.
The second record set stacked into the union under a shared aligned schema.
The unioned output relation combining the aligned inputs by position and type.

known_failure_modes: Columns are aligned by name when the inputs order them differently, so values land in the wrong column.
One input has an extra column and the union widens silently, misaligning the tail rows.

title: Unit Test For Model

slots.description: The model whose transformation logic is exercised against mock inputs and expected rows.

known_failure_modes: The mock inputs omit the boundary case being fixed, so a regression still ships green.
The expected rows encode the old buggy behavior, so the fix appears to fail.

title: Wide Table From Star For Fact

slots.description: The star-schema fact whose dimensions are denormalized onto each fact row.

known_failure_modes: A fan-out join multiplies fact rows because the join cardinality policy was not enforced.
Column name collisions across dimensions overwrite attributes in the wide output.

title: Window Rank Within Partition

slots.description: The relation ranked within each declared partition by the window order key.

known_failure_modes: The partition key is omitted, so ranks run across the whole table instead of per group.
Ties are ranked with row_number semantics where dense rank was intended, skewing top-n cuts.
